item.title: Onyx Launcher 1.6.3: isolated instances, Modrinth, managed Java, and diagnostics
item.description: Onyx Launcher 1.6.3 is available for Windows and Linux with isolated Minecraft instances, integrated Modrinth discovery, managed Eclipse Temurin runtimes, crash diagnostics, Crash Bisect, and portable backups.
